description_en: Retrieves the configurable fields and operators for automated response rules
description_zh: 获取自动化规则策略可配置字段及操作符
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-automate-response-config-feature --auto-response-type event --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutomateResponseConfigFeature

parameters.help_en:
The type of automated response. Valid values:

event: event

alert: alert
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应类型。取值：
event：事件
alert：告警
parameters.name: auto_response_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of view. Valid values:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: the view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator account
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of threat analysis is deployed. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Assets in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: Assets outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

DataType.description_en: The data type of the condition field for the automated response rule
DataType.description_zh: 自动化响应规则条件字段数据类型
DataType.title_zh: 自动化响应规则条件字段数据类型。

Feature.description_en: The name of the condition field for the automated response rule
Feature.description_zh: 自动化响应规则条件字段名称
Feature.title_zh: 自动化响应规则条件字段名称。

RightValueEnums.description_en: The enumeration of the right operand that corresponds to the field
RightValueEnums.description_zh: 该字段对应的右值枚举值

Value.description_en: The enumeration value of the right operand

ValueMds.description_en: The Medusa code for the enumeration value of the right operand

RightValueEnums.title_zh: 该字段对应的右值枚举值

SupportOperators.description_en: The operators that the field supports
SupportOperators.description_zh: 该字段支持的操作符列表

HasRightValue.description_en:
Indicates whether a right operand is required. Valid values:

true: A right operand is required.

false: A right operand is not required
HasRightValue.description_zh:
是否需要右值。取值：
true：需要
false：不需要
HasRightValue.title_zh:
是否需要右值 取值:
需要：
false：不需要。

Index.description_en: The position of the operator in the list of operators
Index.description_zh: 操作符所处操作符列表位置
Index.title_zh: 操作符所处操作符列表位置。

OperatorDescCn.description_en: The description of the operator in Chinese

OperatorDescEn.description_en: The description of the operator in English

OperatorName.description_en: The display name of the operator

SupportDataType.description_en: The data types that the operator supports. Multiple data types are separated by commas
SupportDataType.description_zh: 当前操作符可以支持的数据类型，以逗号分隔
SupportDataType.title_zh: 当前操作符可以支持的数据类型 以逗号分隔。

SupportTag.description_en: The scenarios that the operator supports. Multiple scenarios are separated by commas, such as aggregation. By default, this parameter is empty
SupportTag.description_zh: 操作符支持场景。多个场景以逗号分隔，如聚合等。默认为空
SupportTag.title_zh: 操作符支持场景 多个场景以逗号分隔 如聚合（AGGREGATE）等 默认为空。

SupportOperators.title_zh: 该字段支持的操作符列表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.

false: The request failed

请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
